title: Requirements-based application
expected: Discover pip requirements without synthesizing package metadata.
Prepare pinned hashed requirements; a requirements-only script must not silently become a wheel.
The entrypoint may need a minimal app hint if discovery is ambiguous.

cases.name: unhashed-requirement
cases.change: Remove the wheel hash from requirements.txt.
cases.expect: Disclose incomplete reproducibility and enforce applicable locked-input policy.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
